verdict.rationale: Parsec's own pricing page says Teams customers can use the Teams API to automate Parsec deployment, which is a first-party deployment-automation claim. Nothing in the evidence describes an MSI package, MDM profile, documented silent-install switches, or a way to preset client configuration at install time. The API docs could not be retrieved (teams-api.md and OpenAPI paths return 404), so the claim is unverified. missing for 10: MSI/MDM packaging, documented silent-install parameters, preset configuration at install, accessible deployment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
